features.name: Homepage live events map hero
features.summary: Full-bleed Leaflet globe on the homepage hero plotting every event with coordinates, with a 'Start building' CTA and a footnote counting event locations across the network. Client-only (Leaflet touches window).

features.name: Homepage ActiveEvents rail
features.summary: Surfaces the next 3 upcoming/live events as cards with RSVP links (luma_url or official_url fallback). Live-event count drives a hero pill.

features.name: Homepage Products section
features.summary: Marketing cards for the core Nebius products (AI Cloud, Token Factory, Serverless) linking to the product landing pages.

features.name: Homepage CodingAgents + UseCases sections
features.summary: Two static marketing sections: CodingAgents showcases coding-agent / IDE integrations that work with Nebius (Cursor, Cline, OpenClaw), and UseCases describes the main workloads builders run (training, fine-tuning, inference at scale).

features.name: Homepage WorkshopSpotlight
features.summary: Features one canonical library workshop in a big slot plus a related rail of two WORKSHOP-type entries; editorially curated via the library_articles 'pinned' flag floating entries to the front.

features.name: Homepage BuilderSpotlight (monthly project)
features.summary: Highlights one community project per month, cycled deterministically on the 1st of each month (UTC) from the projects collection.

features.name: Homepage Community section
features.summary: Static marketing section pitching the builder community (Discord, events, programs) with social/CTA links.

features.name: Homepage Programs section
features.summary: Static section describing builder programs (Ambassador, Local Hosts, Nebius Academy) with hard-coded program metrics (active builders, events run, signups attributed) pending a metrics collection.

features.name: Homepage EcosystemPartners marquee
features.summary: Card/marquee of partner integrations drawn from the bundled ecosystem-partners list (~85 entries), each linking to its docs.

features.name: Homepage Contact + BuildInPublic sections
features.summary: Closing marketing sections: a contact/CTA block and a 'build in public' social-proof block at the bottom of the homepage.

features.name: Events directory with map + city filter
features.summary: Dark full-bleed Leaflet map of upcoming events; click a city pin or chip to filter the Upcoming/Recent lists. Cards deep-link to Luma/Nebius RSVP. Splits upcoming vs past, folds city aliases, and renders venue-local times.

features.name: Events refresh (Luma + nebius.com scrape)
features.summary: Admin-only 'Refresh' button on /events POSTs to /api/events/refresh, which uses Tavily Extract to scrape lu.ma/nebiusAI and nebius.com/events, parses titles/dates/cities, dedupes by normalized title, and upserts into the events collection. A separate /api/scrape-events endpoint is a stub.

features.name: Library index with type/product filters
features.summary: Typography-first grid of workshops, videos, playlists, repos, blogs, and docs with a sticky segmented filter (type + product chips with live counts). Backed by published library_articles.

features.name: Library entry detail page
features.summary: Per-slug detail page; YouTube VIDEO/WORKSHOP entries get an embedded iframe player, others get a 'read on original site' link. Renders optional markdown body via marked.

features.name: Apps (community projects) directory
features.summary: Grid of community + hackathon projects with gradient cover cards, award/featured pills, and a segmented filter (Featured, product focus, Robotics/JetBrains hackathon, Other). Placeholder projects filtered out.

features.name: App / project detail page
features.summary: Per-slug project detail page with repo/demo links, tags, product focus, builder byline, and award/hackathon context.

features.name: Ecosystem unified directory
features.summary: Canonical umbrella page mixing community apps (Directus projects) and partner integrations (bundled list) in one grid with a Kind + product filter and an R3F membrane hero. Includes a 'Submit your project' CTA that opens a prefilled GitHub issue.

features.name: Integrations directory
features.summary: Standalone filterable directory of ~85 partner integrations (product + category chips with live counts). SSG with zero per-request server work; data bundled from ecosystem-partners.ts. Hidden from nav but resolves at its URL.

features.name: Builders Network landing + top-10 leaderboard
features.summary: Bespoke /builders page: a code-owned top-10 leaderboard widget on top, then CMS-authored program-pitch content (Directus pages row slug='builders') rendered through Page Constructor. Links to the full login-gated leaderboard.

features.name: All builders listing
features.summary: Secondary /builders/all page listing the full builder roster beyond the homepage top-10 cut.

features.name: DevRel team directory
features.summary: Grid of active DevRel team members (advocates, engineers, program leads) with bio, region, expertise, and a 'Book office hours' CTA when a calendly_url is set.

features.name: Team member detail page
features.summary: Per-slug profile for a DevRel team member with full bio, expertise, languages, social links, and Calendly booking.

features.name: Office Hours booking
features.summary: Landing page with hand-authored recurring drop-in office hours plus weekly 1:1 slots per advocate (team_members with calendly_url). Booking is auth-gated server-side: signed-out visitors see 'Sign in to book', signed-in get the live Calendly link. Hidden from nav.

features.name: Fellows directory (hidden)
features.summary: Public roll-call of recognized community leaders, driven by a static fellows.ts array (region-grouped roster currently disabled, featured grid shown). Emits noindex,nofollow and is fully hidden from nav/sitemap while curated.

features.name: AI Cloud product landing
features.summary: dev.nebius.com-style landing for AI Cloud: dark hero with Console/Docs CTAs plus quickstarts, videos/workshops, guides, repos, and docs rails. Built from library_articles tagged surface=['ai-cloud'] (fetch-all + JS filter; pinned floats to quickstarts).

features.name: Token Factory product landing
features.summary: Product landing for Token Factory (open-source models via OpenAI-compatible API) with the same rail structure, sourced from library_articles tagged surface=['token-factory'].

features.name: Serverless product landing
features.summary: Product landing for Serverless AI (endpoints + jobs without infra) with the standard quickstarts/videos/guides/repos/docs rails, sourced from library_articles tagged surface=['serverless'].

features.name: CMS catch-all pages (Page Constructor)
features.summary: Catch-all [...slug] route that looks up a published Directus pages row by slug and renders its blocks JSON through Gravity UI Page Constructor (with SEO/OG meta). Reserved slugs with dedicated files are skipped. Powers arbitrary marketing pages like /localhosts, /about-this-build.

features.name: Signup / Builder Program landing
features.summary: Builder Program join page: custom persuasion hero ($100 credits, social proof) with a single CTA to console.nebius.com/signup, followed by supporting Page Constructor blocks reused from the Directus 'home' page (header-blocks stripped).

features.name: Full search results page
features.summary: /search?q= renders a full grid of hits across events, library, and apps, server-fetched at getServerSideProps so results are in the HTML. Kind filter chips narrow client-side without re-querying.

features.name: Search API + header autocomplete
features.summary: GET /api/search backs both the header SearchProposal autocomplete (debounced 200ms, top-6 dropdown) and the /search grid. Primary path queries Typesense (nebius_builders collection); falls back to Directus _icontains across events + library_articles + projects when Typesense is unconfigured or errors.

features.name: Login (Directus-JWT cookie sessions)
features.summary: Email/password login form posts to /api/auth/login, which forwards to Directus /auth/login and stores access+refresh tokens in httpOnly cookies. Supports a ?next= redirect back to the gated page after sign-in.

features.name: Session management + role gating
features.summary: getServerSession reads cookies and pulls the current user from Directus, transparently refreshing+rotating expired access tokens; also supports Directus's native OAuth session cookie. requireRole/enforceRole/enforceRoleApi gate pages and API routes by builder/admin role. /api/auth/me and /api/auth/logout round out the flow.

features.name: Feedback / mockup-review capture
features.summary: POST /api/feedback persists inbound feedback (kind, message, page, email, user-agent) to the Directus feedback_items collection, falling back to console.log so it never drops feedback if the collection is missing.

features.name: Portal dashboard
features.summary: Builder home: stat cards (points, credits claimed, events hosted), a Quick Actions panel linking to host-event/submit-library/claim-credits/apply-ambassador, and a recent-activity feed. Stats are sample data pending wired collections.

features.name: Portal onboarding checklist
features.summary: Points-bearing onboarding checklist (sign up, connect GitHub, claim TF/AI credits, submit first library entry, host first event) with done/earned tallies. Static sample state today.

features.name: Portal profile editor
features.summary: Lets the signed-in builder edit their first/last name; submits PATCH /api/portal/profile, which updates the directus_users row via admin token pinned to the session user id (email read-only).

features.name: Portal activity log + log-new form
features.summary: Activity log listing points-bearing actions (events, library, self-reported) with status pills, plus a /portal/activity/new form to self-report a win (type, proof URL, details). Submission handler to the activities collection is currently a stub (StubCallout).

features.name: Portal my-events + host-event form
features.summary: Lists the builder's hosted events and a per-event detail view. /portal/events/new POSTs to /api/portal/events, which does a two-step write: create an events row (status=DRAFT, builder=session user) then a linked credit_requests row (kind=EVENT), rolling back the event if the credit request fails.

features.name: Portal library submission
features.summary: Form for builders to submit a library entry (title, type, level, external URL, blurb, optional markdown body) for review; accepted entries earn +50 pts and publish on /library. Submission write to library_articles is currently a stub.

features.name: Portal intro credit claims (TF + AI Cloud)
features.summary: Two claim forms (/credits/claim-tf, /credits/claim-ai) that POST to /api/portal/credits/claim, creating a credit_requests row (amount_usd=100, status=PENDING, builder=session user). AI Cloud claims require a justification; TF claims need only the account email.

features.name: Portal Ambassador application
features.summary: Application form (handle, email, city/country, what they've built, meetups to host, communities) that POSTs to /api/portal/ambassador/apply, creating an ambassador_applications row (status=PENDING, builder=session user) for monthly admin review.

features.name: Portal full leaderboard
features.summary: Auth-gated full builder leaderboard (moved from public /leaderboard) ranked by points_total, rendered live from the builders collection via the shared LeaderboardTable.

features.name: Admin exec dashboard
features.summary: Admin landing with program metric stat cards (events run, signups attributed, credits claimed) and an 'open queues' list linking to each review queue with pending counts. Metrics/counts are sample data.

features.name: Admin builders management
features.summary: Live table of all builders (handle, name, location, tier, points) from the builders collection, intended for viewing profiles and editing tier.

features.name: Admin library submissions queue
features.summary: Review queue listing all library_articles with status; draft entries are the pending set, approved (published) entries appear on /library. Approve/reject handlers are wired in the QueueTable but currently no-ops.

features.name: Admin DevRel team management
features.summary: Live table of team_members (name, title, region, slug, active) for adding/deactivating/updating members; active members surface on /team.

features.name: Admin intro credit claims queue
features.summary: Review queue for intro credit claims (TF auto-approvable for known builders, AI Cloud needs use-case review). Rows are sample data; approve/reject handlers are no-ops.

features.name: Admin per-event credit requests queue
features.summary: Review queue for per-event Token Factory credit requests (allocate $50-500 per attendee). Rows are sample data linked conceptually to credit_requests of kind=EVENT; handlers no-op.

features.name: Admin ambassador applications queue
features.summary: Monthly review queue for ambassador_applications (builder handle, city, submitted date, status). Rows are sample data; approve/reject handlers no-op.

features.name: Admin self-reported activity queue
features.summary: Review queue for builders' self-reported wins (tweets, meetup attendance, referrals) pending points approval, pulled from the activities collection where status=PENDING. Currently renders empty with approve/reject no-ops.

features.name: Public nav + Products/Docs mega-menus
features.summary: Sticky top nav (Events, Library, Ecosystem links) with a ProductsMenu dropdown (AI Cloud / Token Factory / Serverless internal pages) and a DocsMenu dropdown linking out to docs.nebius.com / Token Factory / Tavily / Soperator / Kubernetes etc. Plus header search, theme toggle, and Log in / Get started buttons. Several routes (apps, integrations, fellows, office-hours, team) intentionally hidden from nav.

features.name: Site footer
features.summary: Site-wide footer with link columns (including the 'About the program' link to /builders and links to the otherwise-hidden pages) and brand/social links.

features.name: Light/dark theme toggle
features.summary: Theme toggle in the nav switching the Gravity UI theme between light and dark, persisted client-side.

features.name: Mockup-for-review banner
features.summary: Site-wide top + fixed-bottom banner (mounted in _app.tsx on every page) flagging the build as a non-production stack demo, with an 'About this build' link. Includes a consent banner and first-visit redirect helper.

features.name: Directus CMS SDK layer
features.summary: Typed @directus/sdk client layer: directusServer() (static admin token for SSG/SSR/API), directusAsUser() (per-user token through Directus role permissions), directusPublic() (anon), plus assetUrl() for transformed asset URLs. Schema types all read/written collections.

features.name: Sitemap + SEO
features.summary: Dynamic sitemap.xml route enumerating public + CMS pages, plus per-page Head/OG meta and noindex handling for hidden pages (fellows). ISR revalidation (60s) keeps CMS-backed pages fresh.
